references.text: Delilah uses the same method again by shouting 'The Philistines are upon you, Samson!' while men lie in ambush
A third attempt from Delilah with the same cry about the Philistines, showing the repeated pattern in the story
Delilah shouts again that the Philistines are coming, but this time Samson's strength is gone because the Lord has left him
The Spirit of the Lord comes upon Samson and the ropes on his arms become like flax burned by fire - similar imagery about ropes breaking
The Spirit of the Lord comes powerfully upon Samson and gives him supernatural strength, explaining his hidden power
